title: KubeCon EU 2026 - Travel & Admin Scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad for travel/admin logistics for KubeCon EU 2026 (Fira Barcelona) — working notes, vendor contacts, expense reminders, and to-dos. Mostly for my own reference + to hand off to Emma/Noah if needed.

Event summary
- Dates: April 20-22, 2026 (setup Apr 19 afternoon)
- Booth: B14 (island) — 3m x 6m, carpeted, power + single AV drop
- Team attending: Harper (lead logistics), Emma (on-site ops), Noah (booth lead), Samantha (engineering demos)

Important deadlines
- Booth shipment deadline to venue: Apr 14 (arrive by 9am) — confirmed with freight forwarder
- AV final spec due to ExpoTech: Apr 10
- Final headcount for badges to show organizers: Apr 12
- Expense cut-off for prepaid items (finance): Apr 30 for April monthly close

Travel bookings (personal/assigned)
- Harper: Flight booked on IB293 BCN from SFO (via MAD) outbound Apr 18 16:35, return Apr 23 12:10. PNR: HPR123. Airline baggage: 1 checked + carry-on.
- Emma: booked via company travel agency (GlobeTrek) — contact Marta if changes needed.
- Noah: arriving Apr 19 morning.
- Hotel: NH Fira Palace — group block under Redwood Inference (block code REDWOOD_KC). Check-in Apr 18, check-out Apr 23.

Packing / on-site kit checklist (booth)
- Laptop + charger + dongles (Harper, Noah, Samantha)
- Demo device (NVIDIA Jetson unit) + power bricks
- Backup HDMI cable, USB-C cable, ethernet cable (2x)
- Booth signage: two printed banners (arriving with freight)
- Business cards (~400) + stickers + giveaway (USB drives)
- Toolkit: gaffer tape, zip ties, scissors, multi-tool
- Extension cords / power strips (ExpoTech will provide, but carry spares)

Vendor contacts (primary)
- ExpoTech (AV & rigging) — Luis Garcia, lead tech
  - Email: luis.garcia@expotech.es
  - Phone: +34 612 345 678
  - Notes: Confirmed single AV drop + 42" monitor. Quote #ET-7789. Follow-up: send final input list by Apr 10.
- EuroFreight Logistics (freight forwarder / booth shipping) — Marta Alvarez
  - Email: marta.alvarez@eurofreight.es
  - Phone: +34 600 111 222
  - Booking ref: EF-5591-RED
  - Notes: Pickup scheduled Apr 9 from Redwood SF office; customs paperwork required (commercial invoice + NAFTA not applicable). Confirm arrival at venue by Apr 14.
- Hospitality / Catering (small booth snacks) — CaterBar SL — contact: Ivan Ruiz
  - Email: ivan@caterbar.es
  - Phone: +34 644 888 333
  - Notes: Light snack tray for staff (Apr 19-21 mornings), water bottles; approx €120/day. Invoice to finance after event.
- Photographer (onsite shots) — PixelMoments
  - Contact: Ana Moreno
  - Email: ana@pixelmoments.com
  - Phone: +34 622 555 101

Expense & reimbursement reminders
- Company policy: use Ramp for all card expenses; personal reimbursements via Expensify -> Finance (finance@redwood.ai).
- Project code to use for KubeCon expenses: RD-ENG-2026-KC (submit this on all expense entries).
- Per diem guidance (for EU): €60/day per staff (covers meals). If meals are on company card, note as billable and tag project code.
- Prepaid vendor invoices (ExpoTech, EuroFreight, CaterBar) should be routed to finance@redwood.ai with PO# if required. Save PDFs of invoices + proof of payment.
- Receipts: take photos immediately; upload to Expensify under "KubeCon EU 2026". For cash tips or small purchases, annotate who bought it and business purpose.
- Credit card limits: vendor payments over €5,000 need pre-approval from finance (email finance@redwood.ai and cc events-ops).

Expense line-item estimates (rough)
- Booth & AV: €6,200 (paid deposit 50% — keep final invoice)
- Shipping/freight: €1,100 (estimate + customs)
- Travel (flights/hotels for 4): €6,000 (estimate)
- Catering & hospitality: €600
- Misc (swag, giveaways, contingency): €1,200
- Total est: ~€15k — will reconcile after event.

On-site schedule (proposed)
- Apr 19 (setup)
  - 08:00 — Freight arrives / ExpoTech set-up begins
  - 11:00 — Booth layout check / install monitor (Harper + Noah)
  - 15:00 — Vendor walk-through with venue rep
  - 18:00 — Team check-in + quick product test
- Apr 20-22 (show days)
  - 08:30 — staff briefing at booth
  - 09:00-18:00 — exhibit hours (rotate 2-3 hour shifts)
  - 17:30 — daily sync on leads + demo issues
- Apr 22 (evening) — optional customer dinner (tentative list from GTM)
- Apr 23 — tear-down; freight pickup by 15:00

Leads & demos process
- Noah manages lead intake spreadsheet (Google Sheet link in Confluence). Scan badge or collect business card + add notes. Prioritize demo leads with product interest.
- Demos: 15-minute slot ideal; have 3 pre-baked demo flows (low-latency chat, embeddings search, reranking). Ensure local docker images available (do not depend on hosted API).

Open questions / to follow up
- Confirm final AV monitor size and whether ExpoTech will provide HDMI -> USB-C adapter.
- Confirm freight customs paperwork (EuroFreight needs signed commercial invoice).
- Finalize headcount for complimentary exhibitor meals (organizer deadline Apr 12).
- Confirm photographer arrival time and shot list with Ana.

Quick tasks (today)
- [ ] Send final AV spec to Luis (ExpoTech) — target: Mar 11 (Harper)
- [ ] Upload flight receipts to Ramp & Expensify once boarding passes issued (everyone)
- [ ] Share final booth staff schedule in Slack channel #events-kubecon (Emma)
- [ ] Confirm demo images and local build tag with engineering (Samantha)

Notes to self
- Keep all invoices in a single Google Drive folder (KubeCon-EU-2026/invoices) and tag finance contact in the doc.
- If anything gets delayed, escalate to Marta (GlobeTrek) or to events-ops@redwood.ai.
- For ad-hoc expenses paid personally, reimburse within 7 days to make month close easier.

Hand-off checklist for Emma/Noah (if Harper not available)
- Freight tracking + confirm delivery Apr 14
- Final AV checklist + monitor connect test Apr 19 14:00
- Badge pickup + exhibitor passes distribution Apr 19 16:00
- Lead sheet sync daily and Dropbox of photos to marketing

End of scratchpad. Will tidy and move to Confluence after logistics stabilized.
